summary: Frontend-only regression check after the TRAIL_WINDOW_MS / buildTrail scope fix in pages/Dashboard.jsx. Verified Dashboard load (no 'Fehler beim Laden' banner), KPI strip + sparklines, animated EnergyFlow, 3s live polling updates, and all 6 routes (/, /verlauf, /steuerung, /geraete, /diagnose, /integrationen) via direct URL load AND SPA nav clicks. Browser console + pageerror listeners captured on every page: ZERO ReferenceError ('is not defined'), zero pageerrors, zero console errors.

issues: Only 5 of 6 KPI tiles render a sparkline: 'Einspeisung (Gesamt)' (data-testid kpi-grid-export-total) has no spark series wired in KpiStrip.jsx line 18, so its tile looks visually inconsistent/empty vs the other five. Cosmetic only.

action_items: Optional (cosmetic): add a spark series (e.g. trail.grid negative/export channel) to the 'Einspeisung (Gesamt)' KPI tile in components/KpiStrip.jsx so all 6 tiles show a trendline.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correct: TRAIL_WINDOW_MS (const) and buildTrail are now inside Dashboard() (lines 60-67) and resolve fine in the polling useEffect closure. Note buildTrail is re-created every render but is only referenced inside a mount-once effect, so no stale-closure or lint-dep problem in practice; if it later becomes an effect dependency, wrap in useCallback or move back to module scope.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified pages/results: Dashboard renders data-testid 'dashboard', 'top-kpi' with 6 tiles (kpi-pv-total 3,36kWh / kpi-pv-now 2.040W / kpi-grid-import 1,54kWh / kpi-grid-now 642W / kpi-consumption 4,01kWh / kpi-grid-export-total 0,80kWh), 5 sparkline polylines, demo-banner visible, live-battery value changes across 4s poll => 3s polling works. /verlauf renders 6 recharts surfaces (no history-error). /steuerung shows Hoymiles limit slider + Trucki setpoint/ZEPC controls. /geraete renders device form testids (switch-demo, input-shelly-ip etc). /diagnose shows btn-run-tests and 'keine MQTT-Daten' placeholders (expected in demo mode, MQTT disconnected). /integrationen shows status-row (MQTT/InfluxDB/Victron GETRENNT, POLLER 77 snapshots) and config forms. Backend was not exercised beyond what the UI calls; the Selbst-Test button (btn-run-tests) and form save/submit POST flows were NOT clicked - next agent may cover those.
rca_of_the_issue: Original ReferenceErrors were caused by module-scope identifiers (TRAIL_WINDOW_MS, buildTrail) not being resolvable inside the useEffect async closure under the dev-server Fast Refresh + visual-edits transform. Moving both declarations into the Dashboard component scope resolves it; confirmed by clean console/pageerror capture and successful data render on repeated loads and SPA navigations.
